prs.location:
Dublin on your doorstep

Sandymount Strand and the sweep of Dublin Bay to one side. Grand Canal Dock and the city centre within easy reach on the other. Glass Bottle sits at one of Dublin's most sought-after addresses — where the energy of the city meets the calm of coastal living.

Walk to Sandymount beach, cycle the coastal routes with Moby Bikes stations at your door, or jump on the 82 and S2 bus routes right outside Glass Bottle for the city centre. When you need to go further afield, a Hertz Car Share is on site. Add to that some of Dublin's best restaurants and cafés, and the open space of Irishtown Nature Reserve on your doorstep, and you have a location that's genuinely hard to beat. This is a place that works as hard as you do — and knows when to slow down.

description:
City living shaped by the sea, Lime House is a collection of 212 fully furnished studio, 1, 2 and 3 bedroom rental homes at the heart of the Glass Bottle waterfront in Dublin 4, moments from Grand Canal Dock, the city's Central Business District and the coast.

This is city living with something extra. The energy and pace of Dublin on one side, the calm of the bay on the other. Innovation and creativity alongside wellness, nature and water. 

Lime House has  A-rated apartments across studio, 1, 2 and 3 bedroom layouts, each thoughtfully decorated and fully furnished. Residents enjoy access to an exceptional range of amenities: a gym and fitness studio, rooftop terraces, a private screening room, sky lounge and private dining, flexible co-working spaces, landscaped courtyards, a residents' lounge and a calendar of events curated for the community.

These contemporary apartments are finished to a high specification with bright open-plan layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows and modern kitchens and bathrooms. 

To find out more or book a viewing, visit https://www.limehouse.ie/book-a-viewing
features: Residents' Lounges — Beautifully designed shared spaces to relax, socialise and get to know your neighbours.
Gym and Fitness Studio — A fully equipped gym and studio to support an active, balanced lifestyle — right on your doorstep.

Private Screening Room — Your own residents-only cinema for film nights, sports screenings and everything in between.
Pet Friendly — A home that welcomes every member of the family, four-legged ones included.
Onsite Management Team — A dedicated team on hand to ensure everything runs smoothly, every day.
Underground Bike Storage — Convenient storage for your bikes.
Landscaped Courtyards — Beautifully planted outdoor spaces at the water's edge, perfect for fresh air and quiet moments.
